verdict.rationale: Docusign's documented eSignature platform lets you send, sign and manage any agreement, with reusable shared templates, configurable workflows and data pulled from systems of record. That plausibly covers signing offer letters, NDA/IP assignments and option-grant documents, but nothing in the evidence addresses hiring or equity paperwork specifically. Missing for 10: any documented HR/offer-letter or equity/option-grant workflows or templates, integration with HRIS or cap-table systems, and independent or hands-on corroboration of use for hiring or equity paperwork.
